title: Hardware Procurement Markup and Quote Validity Schedule
content:
The Hardware Procurement figures below fix, for each order type, the markup on the distributor's unit cost, the ClearPath markup reduction in percentage points, the lowest ClearPath tier rank that earns that reduction, and how long a quote stays open for signature.

| Order type | Markup on distributor unit cost (percent) | ClearPath markup reduction (percentage points) | Lowest ClearPath tier rank earning the reduction (rank 1 to 6) | Quote validity (calendar days after the quote date) | Revised quote starts a new validity period | Signed price honoured if distributor cost rises before the purchase order |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Accessory & Peripheral Order | 22 | 3 | 3 | 14 | Yes | Yes |
| Standard Endpoint Order | 15 | 3 | 3 | 14 | Yes | Yes |
| Staged Endpoint Order | 15 | 3 | 3 | 14 | Yes | Yes |
| Network Equipment Order | 18 | 3 | 3 | 14 | Yes | Yes |
| Server & Storage Build Order | 12 | 2 | 3 | 10 | Yes | Yes |
| Special-Order Equipment | 20 | 2 | 3 | 7 | Yes | Yes |

## Notes on the schedule

- The reduction is stated in percentage points taken off the markup percentage, not as a percentage of it: 18 percent less 3 points is 15 percent, and 12 percent less 2 points is 10 percent.
- The lowest rank earning the reduction is 3 for every order type: a ClearPath tier of rank 3 or above meets it, ranks 1 and 2 do not.
- Quote validity is counted in calendar days after the quote date. Every order type has a revised quote start a new validity period, and every order type honours the signed price even if the distributor's cost changes before the purchase order is placed.

### Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical accessory unit costs 100.00 from the distributor. A markup of 22 percent on it is 22.00, giving 122.00; a markup of 22 percent less 3 points, that is 19 percent, gives 119.00.
